reply: Added durable canonical control-plane RPC coverage of optional GitHub specification failure, Google catalog availability, and a subsequent Gmail setup/read/cancel. The existing Playwright unavailable-spec test also passes, but its Node control-plane execution is not included in V8 coverage.

The non-local guard remains intact. Added a coverage exemption: starting that branch requires the Cloud Run/PostgreSQL host; the canonical local tests verify both the default github.com origin and explicit fixture origin via OAuth RPCs. This limit is recorded in the PR description.

The pinned fixture is now gzip-compressed as fixtures/github-openapi.json.gz so the evidence side commit stays small. The same full JSON document is decompressed before Executor installs it; assertions still require more than 500 GitHub tools and installation under 30 seconds.
